environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate in a VPC with an Application Load Balancer (internet-facing, public subnets). Redis ElastiCache cluster used for caching (cache-manager-redis-store). Service is accessible via public ALB DNS name on port 443. No WAF rules attached. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No API Gateway or authentication middleware configured.
